explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/838: Erdős proved n^{c₁ log n} < f(n) < n^{c₂ log n}. The statement asserts constants c₁, c₂ > 0 with both bounds for all n ≥ 2. Uniform constants exist: small n are absorbed by taking c₁ small and c₂ large, using 1 + n + C(n,2) ≤ f(n) ≤ 2^n. Counting empty sets, singletons and pairs as convex shifts the count only by a polynomial, which is harmless. Faithful.
